wizard.title: Design a Tiny Habit
wizard.science: Based on BJ Fogg's Tiny Habits method — small behaviors + anchors + celebration = lasting change.

anchor.title: Choose your anchor
anchor.desc: An existing routine you already do every day. This is your trigger.

behavior.title: Define a tiny behavior
behavior.desc: Something so small it takes less than 30 seconds. Start absurdly small.

celebration.title: Pick a celebration
celebration.desc: Immediate positive emotion wires the habit into your brain. Make it fun!

edit.science: The if-then sentence is regenerated from your answers.

insights.science: Habit science: consistency beats intensity. Track your recovery rate, not just streaks.
